title: Semblables
html_source: One’s counterparts, equals, or peers; used in Middle English (as an adjective meaning “like, similar”): from Old French, from sembler “to seem.” In modern French, it means “similar” (adj) or “fellow being” (noun). What a tonguejoy to say!
